optimizer.synergy: Warp Stream's quicker blink and ultimate haste bring Queen's Garden up more often, then armor and health keep Adele standing in her Thornbush while Thorns empower allies.

items.Warp Stream: First buy: quicker blink to land Imperial Lash roots and more Queen's Garden casts.
items.Stonewall: Second, cuts physical damage so Adele survives diving fighters and carries.
items.Forticus: Shield and size boost while engaging, stacking with Iron Rose damage reduction.
items.Raiment of Renewal: Missing-health regen keeps Adele healthy between fights without backing.
items.Catalytic Drive: Magic armor plus a gold-paying execute basic attack for support farm.
items.Unbroken Will: Last: tenacity and a burst of extra armor for long front-line fights.

metaBuilds.synergy: Adele dives with Imperial Lash and Royal Flourish, so Dynamo's damage boost on rooted targets comes first, then armor and tenacity keep her alive inside Queen's Garden.

optimizer.synergy: All-in damage: Alternator boosts Imperial Lash, Mutilator chunks max health with each ability, and penetration lets her hits finish targets trapped in Queen's Garden.

items.The Perforator: Third: ignores armor so Royal Flourish still hurts tanks.
items.Spear Of Desolation: Fourth: ultimate haste brings Queen's Garden back sooner.
items.Painweaver: Fifth: stacking penetration and speed while she keeps chasing.
items.Dread: Last: blocks magic burst so she survives diving onto mages.

optimizer.synergy: A full damage line: Alternator and Mutilator boost Q and R's physical hits, then Perforator, Spear and Painweaver punch through armor before Dread blocks magic burst.

items.The Perforator: Third: ignores armor and adds a light slow so tanks still feel Q.
